label: Wan Animate 2 (14B DiT SOTA)
description: Alibaba Tongyi Lab's newest state-of-the-art character animation DiT. Copies motion, hands and facial movement from the driving video into the reference character. This engine is pose-driven; use Wan 2.2 Animate Mix for source-performer removal and true replacement conditioning.
notes: Uses native WanAnimate2ToVideo. Runs in INT8 on free 16 GB T4 (~3-5 min), or ultra-fast on Colab Pro L4 / A100 GPUs (~40-60s).
